title: 第178章 天下即朕，朕即天下！
slug: 满级小李飞刀我在水浒当判官
content_zh:
李逸扭头一看，发现赵佶正背负着双手，笑盈盈地站在自己身后。

他连忙放下酒杯，拱手冲着赵佶深深鞠了一躬。

这可是皇帝，真正的九五至尊。

虽然心里鄙夷，但表面功夫，可还得做做。

“臣李逸，见过官家！”

可惜，她盯得眼睛发红，刚才那样奇怪的画面却没有再出现，反倒是心口越来越疼。

帝督忍不住伸出了手，打算扶理子一把，也好让理子的腿可以减轻一点负担，这也不违背理子想要自己走出去的信念。

虽然没有枪炮之声，但当陈耀来到这里的时候还是见到了满地的尸首，十几个死去的人都是龙卫，竟然没有一个敌人的影子，陈耀暗暗的呼出一口气，嘴角掠过一抹愤怒，在自己的地盘被人袭击，难免心情会很糟糕。

虽然在禁忌之地的时候觉得林洛溪说的话是真的，但是现在封印不稳定的情况下，还是愿意去欺骗自己，林洛溪是在说假话。

赵丰年也不说话，只是极平静的看着他们，如同往日一般无二，但是被他扫过的老头儿却都忍不住想要哆嗦。

要知道一株灵草，特别是珍贵的灵草，从幼年到长成，少则数百年，多则上千年，甚至万年也非常平常，夏启不过练气期的修士，寿元不过一百多年，哪有这么长的时间等待灵草长成？

杨建东回到自家别墅后，关上了大门，一脸疲倦地坐到了大厅的沙发上，背靠着沙发背，闭目养神。

有骄傲自恋的罗濠教主顶在前线，帝督可以趁机夺取沃班原来的猎物，能让沃班这么心动的不从之神，肯定是个厉害的人物。

在他们的眼中，神域也毕竟持续的维持现在这样一个状态，直到永久。

最终她对印第安人大叔致歉，说她要等男友回来和他一起商量一下。

秦瑾瑜和秋水一同来到医馆门口的时候，一具盖着白布的遗体正从里面被抬出来。

郑悦面露愁容，微微托着下巴看着前方发呆，苏无双见他突然停下吃饭的动作，竟然在一边托着下巴，发着呆，疑惑的她微微推了下，他问道。

这会让，梁教授才从那边抬头朝她看了一眼，表情却很淡，接着又继续低头看稿子去了。

不要问她为啥如此细致谨慎，因为她这些年目睹了几位皇子亲哥从军营里回来后被晒成黑炭的惨样，也见证了自恃美貌不肯防晒的亲妹魏清婉从白的发光到不那么白的转变。

迟早觉得这话还是很有可信度的，但是吧，男人嘛，还是喜欢漂亮的，卫骁绝不会不例外。

而挽着秦老太太刚好走进餐厅的钟思娴，也听见了这段对话，脸色顿时难看了几分。

冯璐看出了他说临时有事，急匆匆的走了一趟回来心情就变了，她也听下面的人说了，他的车是往郊外开的。

直至临走前，他都没同他们三人说上任何一句话。只扬扬手，将阿英又招了回去，嘴里旁若无人，像唱曲似的，慢悠悠地说着。

“寒总，你让我办这种事，是不是不太道德？”电话那头，是满长安的声音，听起来像是带着嬉笑，也有着严肃。

体育馆四周呈环形向上，一层层的座位在道道环形中分布，一直到四层高。这便是观众席。中央则是十来个篮球场，篮球场正前方便是一个舞台。而今天比赛选手决斗的舞台便是这里。
content_en:
Li Yi turned around and saw that Zhao Ji was standing behind him with his hands behind his back and a smile.

He quickly put down his wine glass and bowed deeply to Zhao Ji.

This is the emperor, the real Nine-Five Supreme.

Although I despise it in my heart, I still have to do it on the surface.

"Your Majesty, Li Yi, has met the official family!"

Unfortunately, her eyes were red from staring, and the strange scene just now did not appear again. Instead, her heart hurt more and more.

The Emperor couldn't help but stretched out his hand, intending to give Lizi a hand so that the burden on her legs could be relieved. This did not go against Lizi's belief that she wanted to go out on her own.

Although there was no sound of gunfire, when Chen Yao came here, he still saw corpses all over the ground. The dozen or so dead people were all Dragon Guards, and there was no sign of an enemy. Chen Yao breathed out secretly, with a touch of anger flashing at the corner of his mouth. Being attacked on his own territory would inevitably make him feel bad.

Although he felt that what Lin Luoxi said was true when he was in the Forbidden Land, now that the seal is unstable, he is still willing to deceive himself. Lin Luoxi is telling lies.

Zhao Fengnian didn't say anything, but looked at them very calmly, just like before, but the old man who was swept by him couldn't help but tremble.

You must know that it is very common for a spiritual grass, especially a precious spiritual grass, to grow from childhood to maturity, ranging from hundreds of years to thousands or even ten thousand years. Xia Qi is only a monk in the Qi training period, and his lifespan is only more than a hundred years. How can he wait for such a long time for the spiritual grass to grow?

After Yang Jiandong returned to his villa, he closed the door and sat on the sofa in the hall with a tired look on his face. He leaned against the back of the sofa and closed his eyes to rest.

With the arrogant and narcissistic leader Luo Hao on the front line, the Emperor can take the opportunity to seize Woban's original prey. The god of disobedience who can make Woban's heart beat so much must be a powerful figure.

In their eyes, the Divine Realm will continue to maintain its current state forever.

Finally, she apologized to the Indian uncle and said that she would wait for her boyfriend to come back and discuss it with him.

When Qin Jinyu and Qiu Shui arrived at the door of the medical center together, a body covered with white cloth was being carried out from inside.

Zheng Yue looked sad, holding her chin slightly and looking forward in a daze. Su Wushuang saw that he suddenly stopped eating and actually held his chin on one side, dazed. She pushed it slightly in confusion and asked him.

This made Professor Liang look up at her from the other side, but his expression was very indifferent, and then he continued to look down at the manuscript.

Don't ask her why she is so meticulous and cautious, because over the years she has witnessed the miserable appearance of several of the prince's brothers who were sunburned after returning from the military camp, and she has also witnessed the transformation of her sister Wei Qingwan, who relies on her beauty and refuses to use sun protection, from glowing white to not so white.

Sooner or later, I feel that this statement is still very credible, but, men still like beautiful people, and Wei Xiao will never be an exception.

Zhong Sixian, who happened to walk into the restaurant with Mrs. Qin on her arm, also heard this conversation, and her face suddenly turned ugly.

Feng Lu saw that he said he had something to do at the last minute, and after a hurried trip, his mood changed. She also heard from the people below that his car was driving to the suburbs.

Until before leaving, he didn't say a word to the three of them.He just raised his hand and called A Ying back, speaking slowly as if there was no one else around, like singing a song.

"Mr. Han, isn't it unethical for you to ask me to do such a thing?" Man Changan's voice sounded on the other end of the phone, sounding both playful and serious.

The gymnasium is surrounded by a ring upwards, with layers of seats distributed in the ring, all the way to the fourth floor.This is the auditorium.In the center are a dozen basketball courts, and right in front of the basketball courts is a stage.The stage for today's contestants' duel is here.
